title: UK Company Accounts: Net Assets, Cash, Staff (Companies House) — filters

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Current register (default), or only the accounts added or changed since a date — schedule a daily run in changes mode to see each new set of accounts as it is filed and pay only for what changed.

since.title: Changes since
since.description: Changes mode only: YYYY-MM-DD. Default: the last 7 days. The feed keeps 90 days.

change.title: Change type
change.description: Changes mode only: one kind of change. Default: all.

company_number.title: Company number
company_number.description: Companies House number as the register writes it, e.g. 00519500 or SC123456 — every set of accounts held for the company.

company.title: Company name contains
company.description: Registered company name as tagged in the accounts (case-insensitive substring).

balance_sheet_date_after.title: Balance sheet dated on or after
balance_sheet_date_after.description: Only accounts drawn up to a date on or after this one (YYYY-MM-DD)

file_date_after.title: Published on or after
file_date_after.description: Only accounts carried by a Companies House daily file dated on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

net_assets_max.title: Net assets at most (£)
net_assets_max.description: Set to -1 for companies with net liabilities (negative net assets).

net_assets_min.title: Net assets at least (£)
net_assets_min.description: Companies whose balance sheet shows at least this much in net assets.

cash_min.title: Cash at bank at least (£)
cash_min.description: Cash-rich companies: at least this much cash at bank and in hand.

employees_min.title: Employees at least
employees_min.description: Average number of employees in the period is at least this.

employees_max.title: Employees at most
employees_max.description: Average number of employees in the period is at most this.

dormant.title: Dormant companies only
dormant.description: Tick for accounts that declare the company dormant.

max_results.title: Maximum results
max_results.description: Stop after this many sets of accounts (you are charged per result).
